adaptations.behavior: one bidi paragraph and visual run order span inline element boundaries
adaptations.terminalAdjustment: visual text commands and fixed-point line fragments are asserted instead of shaped browser glyphs

adaptations.behavior: line alignment and bidi reordering are separate used-value steps
adaptations.terminalAdjustment: start and end positions are asserted in CSS pixels before terminal snapping

adaptations.behavior: text-align start follows the used paragraph direction
text-align end follows the used paragraph direction
UAX #9 line resets and reordering run after logical line selection
adaptations.terminalAdjustment: the terminal display list consumes visual runs while search remains logical

adaptations.behavior: CSS white-space processing precedes bidi paragraph construction
adaptations.terminalAdjustment: source-linked logical text units are inspected directly

adaptations.behavior: line-break anywhere remains constrained to extended grapheme-cluster boundaries
adaptations.terminalAdjustment: terminal glyph width does not redefine Unicode boundaries

adaptations.behavior: overflow-wrap anywhere introduces emergency opportunities without splitting clusters
adaptations.terminalAdjustment: line selection uses fixed-point CSS-pixel advances

adaptations.behavior: the standardized legacy break-word behavior is retained as CSS line tailoring
adaptations.terminalAdjustment: intrinsic sizing differences outside Verge's supported slice are not claimed

adaptations.behavior: word-break keep-all suppresses default CJK opportunities where specified
adaptations.terminalAdjustment: Unicode 17 line-break classes supply the script-independent property data

adaptations.behavior: emergency wrapping never splits an extended grapheme cluster
adaptations.terminalAdjustment: wide terminal clusters remain one atomic paint unit

adaptations.behavior: regional-indicator pairs remain one grapheme cluster during bidi layout
adaptations.terminalAdjustment: terminal width is applied only after the visual run is fixed

adaptations.behavior: CSS direction establishes the paragraph base direction without changing logical source order
adaptations.terminalAdjustment: the used direction is asserted through visual line runs in horizontal writing mode

adaptations.behavior: unicode-bidi embeddings and overrides insert structural bidi controls around inline content
adaptations.terminalAdjustment: structural controls exist only in the bidi item stream and never alter author text

adaptations.behavior: generated content participates in the containing bidi paragraph
adaptations.terminalAdjustment: generated ranges retain pseudo-element and formatting-node identity

adaptations.behavior: manual soft hyphens paint only when their selected opportunity ends a line
adaptations.terminalAdjustment: the inserted hyphen is a source-linked visual text cluster

adaptations.behavior: wbr contributes a structural break opportunity without contributing logical search text
adaptations.terminalAdjustment: the test asserts retained logical match identity as well as bounded layout

adaptations.behavior: tab-size is inherited and determines preserved tab stops during line selection
adaptations.terminalAdjustment: tab stops are resolved in fixed-point CSS pixels before terminal snapping
